facts.business: Anthem Biosciences Limited is an innovation-driven and technology-focused Contract Research, Development and Manufacturing Organization (CRDMO) with fully integrated operations spanning drug discovery, development, and manufacturing, including integrated New Chemical Entity (NCE) and New Biological Entity (NBE) commercial manufacturing capabilities.
facts.related_party_note: Loans and advances outstanding as on March 31, 2026: Anthem Bio Pharma Private Limited (Common Directors) - INR 77.68 million; Neoanthem Lifesciences Private Limited (Wholly Owned Subsidiary) - INR 1,954.27 million. Transactions undertaken in ordinary course of business.
